headline: Gutter Flips Warden as Weathered Expanse Battle Rages
war_summary: Latest returns show Gutter turned on its head with ten changes in two hours and thirty-nine on the day about Kuoppa and Lost Kaivo, now standing six Warden to none Colonial with one neutral, against the earlier mixed return, while Weathered Expanse remains the heavy exchange with seven in two hours and twenty-six on the day about Spirit Watch, Necropolis and Crow's Nest, now three Warden to two Colonial with four neutral. Palantine Berm keeps up three in two hours and twenty-one on the day about Vendett and Windburn Landing, now one Warden to six Colonial, and Marban Hollow records seven in six hours and twenty-two on the day about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, now one Warden to five Colonial with two neutral. Nevish Line and Linn Mercy have gone quiet in the last two hours with nineteen and thirteen on the day respectively, holdings unchanged at seven to one and two to eight with one neutral, and Godcrofts is silent after twenty-six on the day. Callahan's Passage again reports the heaviest toll near twelve thousand Colonial losses in a day, with Stonecradle above two thousand, neither with a single recorded change.
